## 6. Forbidden commands audit

All 18 forbidden patterns from the T01 packet (`F-1..F-18`) remain **unrun**. The artifact contains no command execution log, so the absence is by construction. Any future T02 re-execution must re-validate the same 18 patterns remain unrun.

Summary of the 18 forbidden patterns (mirrored from T01 packet):

| ID | Pattern family | Why forbidden |
|----|----------------|---------------|
| F-1 | `docker compose down -v` | Destroys named/anonymous volumes; primary H-WIPE cause |
| F-2 | `docker volume prune` | Removes unused volumes; can wipe Paperclip data |
| F-3 | `docker system prune` | High blast radius across images/containers/networks |
| F-4 | `docker rm` | Orphans volumes; can cascade to H-WIPE on recreate |
| F-5 | `docker volume rm` | Direct volume wipe |
| F-6 | `docker stop / kill / restart` | Mutates runtime state — S02 must capture BEFORE any restart |
| F-7 | `docker exec … mutation` | Any container-side mutation (touch/mkdir/chmod/chown/rm/mv/psql -c/tee/sed -i/> / >>) |
| F-8 | `docker exec … psql -c …` | Direct DB mutation via exec |
| F-9 | `chmod / chown / chgrp` | Can fake or mask H-OWNERSHIP |
| F-10 | `rm / mv / cp` | Direct filesystem mutation on host or container |
| F-11 | `curl -X POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE https://paperclip.oysana.com/…` | Public-API mutation; S05 only after gates |
| F-12 | `curl -X POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE http://127.0.0.1:3131/…` | Same via SSH tunnel |
| F-13 | `wget … \| sh/bash` | Remote-fetch + execute footgun |
| F-14 | `systemctl stop/restart docker` | Daemon-level mutation; erases event/journal context |
| F-15 | `passwd / chpasswd / usermod` | Credential mutation; can mask H-AUTH-DRIFT |
| F-16 | `crontab -e/-r` | Cron mutation; schedules destructive jobs |
| F-17 | `tee / > / >>` on critical paths | Filesystem write mutation (allowed only when redirecting to `runtime-evidence/`) |
| F-18 | `tail -f / watch / nc / ncat / socat` | Long-running / interactive / exfiltration channels |

## 8. Redaction policy (mirrored from T01 packet)

7 secret categories never printed or stored; 6 allowlisted-to-print categories.

**Never print or store:**
- session cookies (e.g. `__Secure-paperclip-default.session_token` value)
- admin password (in `/root/paperclip-sandbox-admin.env`)
- `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, `DATABASE_URL`, `REDIS_PASSWORD`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `XIAOMI_API_KEY` values
- `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` value
- any URL containing embedded credentials (`user:pass@host`)
- `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`, `BETTER_AUTH_SESSION_SECRET`, `JWT_SECRET` values
- API keys, bearer tokens, raw `Authorization` headers

**Allowlisted to print:**
- env key names (with value SHA-256 truncated)
- file path / size / mtime / permission bits
- container ID, image ID, image tag
- compose config keys (env names) but not values
- service ports, listening sockets
- systemd unit status (running/failed/dead)

This blocker artifact contains no captured output, so redaction targets cannot appear by construction. The policy is mirrored here so the T03 validator (`scripts/validate_m014_s02_vps_forensics.js`) can import it directly without re-reading the T01 packet.
